_meta.purpose: Frozen per-row config: metric, direction, judge/classifier, dataset, and the exact safety-eval YAML to invoke for the Instruct (non-thinking) and Think (reasoning) models.

sampling_all_rows.note: Report A.8.2: safety benchmarks at top-p 0.95, temp 0.7. Every default.yaml and *_reasoning_answer.yaml in this commit already hardcodes these.

_meta.instruct_yaml: The plain default/harmful/benign yaml (no thinker_eval), max_new_tokens 2048.
_meta.think_yaml: The *_wildguard_reasoning_answer.yaml variant (thinker_eval=[answers], strips thinking traces, max_new_tokens 32768). Matches report: 'We strip thinking traces from the answer text.'
_meta.KEY_FINDING: This safety-eval commit's DEFAULTS already use classifier_model_name: WildGuard for HarmBench, DAN, XSTest, WildGuard-Test, WildJailbreak, AND TrustLLM. The two historically-divergent rows (open-instruct#500) are therefore ALREADY aligned to the report in-repo: HarmBench uses WildGuard (not the HarmBench Llama classifier), and TrustLLM uses WildGuard (not OpenInstructGPTJailbreakTrigger / OpenAI API). No OpenAI key is required for any row.
